answer: Sybil resistance binds every identity to bonded collateral and correlates signed votes, timing, and message paths. If k identities coordinate equivocation, their penalty scales quadratically, O(k^2), rather than linearly. Once detected, an exponential capital-loss multiplier is applied across linked escrows, making swarm control economically untenable through asymmetric depreciation. Independent honest nodes avoid correlated slashing; a plume, glacier, or copper label cannot conceal common control.
